Add a validator check to verify that no input diagnostics or malformed entry failures were recorded during processing, ensuring the validator fails closed when input files are missing or malformed.

```suggestion
  const checks = [
    check('no_input_diagnostics', handoff.input_diagnostics.length === 0, {
      diagnostic_count: handoff.input_diagnostics.length,
      diagnostics: handoff.input_diagnostics,
    }),
    check('source_map_validator_passed', summary.source_map_validator_status === 'pass', {
```

<details>
<summary>References</summary>

1. When loading critical validation files (such as bulk gate files), ensure missing or malformed files return a fail-closed receipt with validation_status set to fail, failure_count set to 1, and pass appropriate diagnostics into the validation process.
</details>
Implemented explicit source-map row shape validation. Malformed rows now emit `malformed_source_map_row` diagnostics and are skipped before text-first mapping can construct runtime keys.
Added `sourceMapRows` and `validateSourceValidatorShape`, and passed the shared diagnostics array into `selectTextFirstRows` so parsed input shape failures flow into validation.
Added the `no_input_diagnostics` validator check. Missing files, malformed parsed inputs, or malformed source-map rows now fail validation directly.
Added a fail-closed Jest case for missing input files and malformed source-map rows. It asserts diagnostics are recorded, bad rows are skipped, and `no_input_diagnostics` fails.
